request.subject: UNIT:CANDY:BATTLESHIP

layers.text: Recolour as a chocolate cake galleon and change no shape: the hull becomes layers of dark chocolate sponge #4a2412, with thin cream filling stripes and a thick caramel gold rim #e0a040, in place of the pink frosting; the sails stay cream white; the masts become caramel gold and cream stripes; the pennants caramel gold; the cake tower dark chocolate with white cream on top. Nothing pink is left. Keep every shape, the size, thick black outline and style the same, on a transparent background.
